mapper.select: SELECT * FROM send_history WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE send_history SET status = #{status}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM send_history WHERE status = 'SCHEDULED' AND scheduled_at <= #{now} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT channel_id FROM send_history_routing WHERE send_history_id = #{sendHistoryId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY priority_order ASC
SELECT * FROM send_target WHERE send_history_id = #{sendHistoryId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT 'send-' || sh.id || '-' || st.id AS messageId, sh.id AS sendHistoryId, st.id AS sendTargetId, sh.template_id AS templateId, sh.id AS campaignId, st.customer_id AS customerId, c.phone AS phoneNumber, c.email AS email, c.kakao_user_key AS kakaoUserKey, sh.title AS title, sh.content AS content, sh.purpose AS purpose FROM send_target st JOIN send_history sh ON sh.id = st.send_history_id JOIN customer c ON c.id = st.customer_id WHERE st.send_history_id = #{sendHistoryId} AND st.status = 'PENDING' AND st.is_deleted = 0 AND sh.is_deleted = 0
